meaning.title: What rescisao without FGTS means here
meaning.p1: On this page, without FGTS means without FGTS termination fine and without immediate FGTS withdrawal in the result.
meaning.p2: It does not mean a CLT worker has no FGTS account or deposits. The official balance may exist outside the termination payout.

resignation.title: Resignation: what is included and excluded
resignation.intro: For resignation, the estimate keeps common cash items and leaves FGTS outside the immediate payout.
resignation.b1: Salary balance for the termination month.
resignation.b2: Proportional 13th salary and overdue or proportional vacation plus one-third.
resignation.b3: Worked, waived, or deducted notice according to the selected option.

withCause.title: Dismissal for cause: limits of this estimate
withCause.p1: For dismissal for cause, this first version estimates salary balance and entered overdue vacation.
withCause.p2: The tool does not decide whether dismissal for cause is valid and does not replace legal, union, accountant, or official payroll review.

notice.title: Deducted notice in resignation
notice.p1: If notice is deducted, the calculator subtracts 30 days of base remuneration.
notice.p2: This can sharply reduce the net estimate and even produce a negative amount when other credits are lower.

fgtsZero.title: Why the FGTS fine stays zero
fgtsZero.p1: Resignation and dismissal for cause are not modeled here as scenarios with an FGTS termination fine or immediate withdrawal.
fgtsZero.p2: To simulate dismissal without cause, mutual agreement, indirect termination, fine base, or FGTS balance, use the full calculator.

disclaimer.title: Important notice
disclaimer.text: This calculator is an educational estimate, not legal, tax, or payroll advice. It does not calculate unpaid FGTS collection or recognize informal employment. TRCT, eSocial, FGTS Digital, official balance, collective agreement, and professional review prevail.

q1.question: Does resignation receive an FGTS fine?
q1.answer: Not in this route. Resignation keeps the FGTS fine at R$0.00 and no immediate withdrawal is displayed.

q2.question: Can resignation withdraw FGTS?
q2.answer: This simulation does not add immediate FGTS withdrawal to the payout. The balance may remain in the account under official withdrawal rules.

q3.question: Does dismissal for cause include FGTS?
q3.answer: This dismissal-for-cause estimate shows FGTS fine and withdrawal as zero while keeping only the planned cash items.

q4.question: Does deposited FGTS disappear after resignation?
q4.answer: No. The page simply does not add the balance to the immediate payout. Check official channels for the account balance.

q5.question: What if the company never deposited FGTS?
q5.answer: This tool does not calculate overdue FGTS collection, informal employment, or damages. Use official channels and professional review.

q6.question: Why did my result become negative?
q6.answer: In resignation with deducted notice, the 30-day deduction can exceed salary balance, 13th salary, and proportional vacation.

q7.question: When should I use the full calculator?
q7.answer: Use it for dismissal without cause, mutual agreement, indirect termination, employer indemnified notice, FGTS fine, base, or withdrawal.
